Metadata.title: HoliJoy · Where hotel animators meet
Metadata.description: A marketplace for animators, hotels and holidaymakers, built on trusted ratings and reviews. Coming soon.

Home.title: Find the stars of hotel entertainment.
Home.subtitle: HoliJoy makes animators' reputations visible and connects hotels and holidaymakers with the right team through verified ratings and reviews.

animators.title: Animators
animators.body: Build your profile and showreel, collect QR-verified reviews from guests, and connect with hotels directly.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.body: Search animators by branch, language and rating; confirm your team and rate them at the end of the season.

guests.title: Holidaymakers
guests.body: Compare hotels by the quality of their entertainment and follow the animators you love.
